cards.text: Banquet number two, friend. Queen Esther has King Xerxes of Persia and Haman, the official the king set above all his princes, back at her table, and she promised to answer the king's question here (Esther 3:1; 5:8). Haman just got rushed over after parading Mordecai, Esther's cousin who raised her, through the city square, and I bet his stomach is in KNOTS (Esther 2:7; 6:11-14).

cards.question: On that second day, as they drink their wine, what does King Xerxes ask Queen Esther once more?

cards.text: The king promises it will be given to her, even up to half the kingdom. So Esther finally says, "If I have found favor in your sight, O king, and if it pleases the king…"

cards.question: Queen Esther finally makes her request. What does she ask King Xerxes for?

answers.text: Her life and her people's lives
A palace and servants of her own
A seat on the king's council

cards.text: Then she says why: she and her people have been sold out to destruction, death and annihilation. I think saying that out loud took everything she had.

cards.question: Esther tells the king that if her people had only been sold as servants, she would have stayed quiet.

cards.text: King Xerxes wants answers: "Who is this, and where is the one who would devise such a scheme?" I bet you could hear a sprinkle drop in that room.

cards.question: King Xerxes wants a name. Who does Queen Esther call the adversary and enemy?
Once Queen Esther names him, Haman stands in ___ before the king and queen.

cards.text: The king gets up from his wine and goes out to the palace garden. Friend, I spent YEARS stuck in the back of a junk drawer, and I would NOT trade places with Haman right now.

cards.question: King Xerxes gets up from his wine and goes out to the palace garden in his ___.
Haman stays behind, and he realizes the king is planning a terrible fate for him. What does Haman do?

answers.text: Begs Queen Esther for his life
Slips out through a side door

cards.text: The king walks back in from the garden at the EXACT moment Haman is falling on the couch where Esther is reclining. Of all the seconds in the whole day, friend. THAT one.
The king exclaims, "Would he actually assault the queen while I am in the palace?"

cards.question: As soon as the words leave King Xerxes' mouth, Haman gets a chance to explain himself.

cards.text: With Haman's face covered, Harbonah, one of the eunuchs attending the king, speaks up. He says there's a gallows fifty cubits high at Haman's house.

cards.question: Harbonah says Haman built that gallows for ___, the man whose report saved the king.
Harbonah has just told King Xerxes about the gallows at Haman's house. The king orders Haman hanged on it.

cards.text: So they hang Haman on the gallows he prepared for Mordecai, and the king's fury subsides. That's where we'll set this batch down for now, friend, because this story is NOT done.
